# Asutosh Dalei

> Personal portfolio of Asutosh Dalei, a data scientist and AI engineer based in Washington, DC, United States, with over four years of industry experience across retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM applications, machine learning, and predictive modeling.

This is the domain root for asutoshdalei.github.io. The full portfolio lives at [asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/), which has its own detailed [llms.txt](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/llms.txt).

## Site map

- [Portfolio home](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/): résumé summary, work experience, research, hobbies, and contact form
- [About](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/about.html): detailed biography and background
- [Contact](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/contact.html): email and social channels
- [Privacy](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/privacy.html): analytics and form-data disclosures
- [Résumé PDF](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/ASUTOSH_DALEI_RESUME.pdf): full up-to-date résumé
- [Agent guide](https://asutoshdalei.github.io/AsutoshDalei/llms.txt): when-to-use guidance and markdown versions of every page
